# Pricing

Start free and scale as your team grows. Simple, transparent pricing with no surprises.

### Free

$0/month

For developers who want Warp’s modern terminal with the flexibility to use Warp’s AI or bring their own.

Includes core terminal features

- ○

State-of-the-art modern terminal
- ○

Warp Agent CLI access

Pay as you go, starting at:

## Warp Factories, now in Early Access

Flexible, open infrastructure to accelerate companies building internal cloud software factories — run fleets of coding agents across your SDLC, on any model or harness.

### Pay as you go

For developers getting started with software factories

Includes standard factory features

- ○ Create and run factories with the Warp Agent
- ○ Automate from GitHub, Slack, webhooks, and schedules
- ○ Insights like cost per PR and automation rate
- ○ Factory config as code in a Warp-managed repo
- ○ Pay-as-you-go usage, 20% markup, no subscription

### Build

For developers building and running factories

Everything in Pay as you go, plus:

- ○ Factory usage covered by your plan's included credits
- ○ 20% savings over pay-as-you-go, at API rates
- ○ Additional usage priced at API rates
- ○ Private email support

### Max

For developers scaling to high-volume workloads

Everything in Build, plus:

- ○ 12x Build's included factory usage
- ○ More compute per cloud agent run
- ○ Additional usage priced at API rates

### Business

For teams scaling factories with more control

Everything in Build, plus:

- ○ Up to 25 seats, with per-seat included credits
- ○ Advanced factory insights and team usage metrics
- ○ SAML-based SSO
- ○ Admin-configurable data controls with ZDR

### Enterprise

For organizations needing infrastructure and governance

Everything in Business, plus:

- ○ Unlimited seats with custom shared usage pools
- ○ Self-hosted workers on your own infrastructure
- ○ Your own code forge for factory config
- ○ BYOLLM inference at no credit cost
- ○ Dedicated implementation engineer

Select teams get up to $10,000 in factory usage during Early Access.

See how factories work and request access.

## The best for the job

Access Fable 5, Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GLM 5.2, Kimi K3, and more. Pick the best model for the task. Run different tasks with different models in parallel, or switch between models for a given task, all without leaving your workflow.

## Agents where you work

Connect Warp to Slack, Linear, and GitHub to get AI help right inside your tools. Mention @Warp to investigate bugs, suggest fixes, or open PRs, all without context-switching. With real-time session links and shared visibility, anyone can see, guide, or review what the agent is doing.

## Transparency and control at every touchpoint.

### Your data, secure and private

Warp is SOC 2 compliant and has Zero Data Retention policies with all contracted LLM providers: no customer data is retained, stored, or used for training. App telemetry can be individually configured and automatically enforced for teams.

### Complete control of your agents

Control exactly how much autonomy agents have, from approving every step to allowing full autonomy. Configurable at the individual and enterprise level.

### Full transparency

You can read the list of high-level telemetry events sent for app analytics and monitor telemetry in real time with our native Network Log.

## Have more questions?

Talk to our team about which plan is right for you.
